verdict.rationale: Gemini API documents an official CLI built for AI agents. A coding agent can use it to generate text and media, analyze files, and delegate tasks to managed agents. Official Skills and a Docs MCP server also prepare AI assistants to drive the API, so natural-language operation works indirectly through the user's agent. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface for operating or managing the product itself, end-to-end documentation of NL-driven operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Gemini API CLI (`gemini-api`) is a stateless, zero-dependency command-line client built for AI agents with shell access, scripts, and CI pipelines.
Loading these skills injects the correct patterns and guidelines directly into your AI assistant's context.
Your agent can search and read documentation pages to check request schemas, model limits, and new features
